# pull fetch origin twice

Make `pull` fetch each remote once. The original output ("Извлечение из origin" = "Fetching from origin", "Уже обновлено" = "Already up to date"):

```
$ pull
Извлечение из origin
Извлечение из origin
Уже обновлено.
```

**Cause:** `git-pull` ran an explicit `git fetch --all --prune --prune-tags --tags` and then `git pull --force --rebase`, and `git pull` fetches again on its own; the second line is that second fetch. Beyond the wasted round trip, the two fetches carried different options (only the first pruned and touched tags), so what `pull` did depended on which of them ran last.

Expected: one fetch per remote per `pull`, with all the intended options (`--prune`, `--tags`, `--force`) on that single fetch, and the rebase on top of it.
